name: Cafe Bettina
beschreibung: The Cafe Bettina in the village of Ellmau is run as an inn with an attached café. The accommodation includes several guest rooms as well as holiday apartments. The café serves homemade pastries and traditional Tyrolean dishes. The location allows excursions into the Kitzbühel Alps and Kaisergebirge. The inn offers both comfortable overnight stays and a welcoming café atmosphere.
